label: H.R. 980
title: Veterans Readiness and Employment Improvement Act of 2025
short_title: Veterans Readiness and Employment Improvement Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

summary: Modernizing the Veterans On-Campus Experience Act of 2025 This bill removes the requirement that educational and vocational counseling services provided by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) on campus at institutions of higher learning must be provided by VA counselors.
summary_short: Modernizing the Veterans On-Campus Experience Act of 2025 This bill removes the requirement that educational and vocational counseling services provided by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) on campus at institutions of higher learning must be provided by VA counselors.
